dedup_note: ~35 pieces of many kinds -> 1 fish + 1 refined_grain serving

notes: The same merge-and-count mechanic as the escargots but at a scale nothing in the set reaches: about 35 pieces across a dozen kinds in one box. One fish serving and one refined_grain serving, not one per piece and not one per kind. Avocado is healthy_fats rather than vegetables, and the cream cheese inside the rolls is the item most likely to vanish into 'sushi'. Sizes are L because the box is a sharing set, not a single portion.
